reuse.why: Introduces one shared category-selection helper used by every month-wide action, reuses setNMonthAvg, extractTagsFromText, getSheetValue and setBudget; the income/tracking rule is still re-checked inline at each action rather than reused from one place.

duplication.why: Collapses the three copied average functions into setMonthWideAverage and replaces three copied category queries with one helper; only the one-line income/tracking guard is still repeated per action.

placement.why: Selection rule, new action and handler registration live in budget/actions.ts and budget/app.ts next to the existing month-wide actions.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the month-wide actions, the new method, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single documented selection function with one explicit flag makes future exclusion rules a one-place edit; copyPreviousMonth's set-intersection over getBudgetData and the per-site income guard are small leftovers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) go through getMonthWideTargetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated queries and average loops are removed and shared, not reshaped; only the short income/tracking guard repeats openly.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories gains includeHiddenCategories (step 4) and one conditional hidden SQL filter; #fixed and templates are part of the base rule; no call site bypasses it.
